headline: Lawro's Predictions: GW6
deck: Lawro's first column in the Gazetta sides with Cowthenbeef and GlengarryHearts against the fancied teams.
body: Five ties, nobody has kicked a ball, and I've already seen enough. Twenty-two years predicting scores on the BBC, and now I'm scraping the bottom of a fantasy draft league's paper.

ties.line: its_ohi are flaky, and I'm backing them anyway. Gibbs-White has Crystal Palace away, a fixture handed to him on a plate. He'll waste it, they always do. B.Fernandes and Cunha both play for Manchester United, who have Tottenham Hotspur at home. B.Fernandes has gone quiet, no goal and no assist in two games. Two men from one club is twice the misery when United have one of their days. its_ohi edge it, and nobody will enjoy watching.

The Raccoons are a side I don't trust, but they're the better lot here. Gonzalo is away at Ipswich Town, and that defence is softer than a wet loaf. Haaland has scored in each of his last two for Manchester City. domeitalycoach went to the waiver list five times this week. Five men nobody else wanted. Havertz, of Arsenal, gets Leeds United and hasn't done a thing in a fortnight. The Raccoons, and I'll be asleep by the second half.

AtleticoTimHortons sit top, and I've never trusted anybody top in October. Tarkowski has a trip to Hull City, whose attack couldn't score in a raffle. He'll keep them quiet and it still won't be enough. Groß has scored in back-to-back games for Brighton & Hove Albion. He'll stop the minute I trust him. Semenyo is a slight doubt. AtleticoTimHortons win it, and it'll be a slog to sit through.

Cowthenbeef are the steadier side, and I'm going against the favourites here. It's all about the back line. Bassey is away at Ipswich Town, who couldn't hit a barn door. Verbruggen has Sunderland away. The Truffle Pigs send Vuskovic and F.Kadıoğlu to Sunderland as well. I played centre-half, and I'd take a trip to Ipswich Town every week. None of it will be pretty, a clean sheet never is. Cowthenbeef.

GlengarryHearts have the better footballers where it matters. Bayern Bru are fancied, and I'm siding against them. Isak is the finest finisher in this tie, and that's plain to anybody. Virgil defends like it's still worth doing properly. Liverpool have Manchester City coming, and neither man will be bothered by it. It's the big game of the weekend, and it'll be cagey. They always are. GlengarryHearts, and I'll sit through every dull minute of it.
